messages:
Sam (Support): Heads-up — TelosBank reported p99 spikes up to ~2.8s after yesterday's quantized v2 rollout on their dedicated pool. Ticket TB-5232. Seeing user-facing lag on payment flow. Tagging @Jordan (Sales) @Elena (Product) for prioritization.
Jordan (Sales): They’re on an enterprise contract and are escalated — asked for an ETA and said they'll consider pausing traffic if SLA not addressed. Started ~03:15 UTC according to them. :warning:
Elena (Product): Thanks. Eng, can you confirm whether this aligns with the quantized model rollout or infra churn (autoscaler/drain)?
Marco (Eng Runtime): Looking. Initial hypothesis: quantization + new batching heuristic increased tail on long-context sessions. Traces show KV cache miss rate jump and heavier per-token decode time for v2-quant-int8.
Marco (Eng Runtime): Snippet from trace (abbrev):
[INFO] req=id=TB-5232 seq=112
  decode_latency: 45ms -> 180ms
  kv_cache_misses: 38 -> 240
  model_variant: v2-quant-int8
Alex (Eng ML): I can reproduce locally on long contexts. int8 kernels degrade on 4096+ contexts under current kernel path. Repro command: `runbench --ctx=4096 --model=v2-quant-int8`
Priya (Eng Platform): Also saw autoscaler churn on that dedicated pool around 03:12 UTC — 2 node replacements. queue_depth spiked while warmups happened. node_restarts=2 in the window. Could be compounding.
Chris (CS): Customer says the lag impacts their payment confirmation page. They want either rollback of quant variant or a mitigation ASAP. Asking for ETA now.
Elena (Product): Options: A) Tenant-scoped rollback to pre-quant model (fast) B) Patch runtime batching/cache heuristics (mid) C) Ask customer to switch to non-quant model or reserved config (slow/neg). Need cost/impact for each.
Jordan (Sales): Rollback looks like the quickest route to prevent SLA churn. They'll dislike cost increase but prefer reliability. We need to give a firm ETA.
Marco (Eng Runtime): Rollback is a config flip for their tenant — low risk and can be done immediately. Note: it will raise their token compute cost ~2x for the duration. Patch (B) will take more time to validate across pools.
Elena (Product): Product preference: emergency rollback for TelosBank, then follow up with engineering fix and perf regression on int8 path. Any objections?
Alex (Eng ML): +1. I'll add a regression test for long-context int8 and run a wider validation against the rollout matrix.
Priya (Eng Platform): I'll apply a temporary anti-drain pin to their pool to avoid autoscaler churn while rollback happens. Also will schedule a short tweak to reduce aggressive node replacements.
Sam (Support): I'll tell the customer ETA = 90m for rollback + verification. @Jordan can you prepare SLA credit / comms?
Jordan (Sales): On it. I'll pre-draft the comms and offer a 1-week credit hold if any repeat incidents. Logging TL;DR into backlog as TB-5330: "Investigate int8 p99 regression" and flag P0 after rollback.
Elena (Product): I'll create a rollback playbook (runbook + checklist) and add rollout launch criteria: perf gate = p99 <= baseline + 10% across 95th percentile of tenants.
deploy-bot: Rollback scheduled for dedicated/pools/telosbank at 05:20 UTC.
Marco (Eng Runtime): Rollback applied at 05:22 UTC — switching TelosBank to v2-fp16. Observing metrics: p99 dropping toward baseline. Monitoring for 20m. :eyes:
Sam (Support): TelosBank confirms latency back to normal, payments flow responsive. They asked to keep us posted on root cause.
Elena (Product): Closing this as an incident after postmortem. Keeping TB-5330 in the backlog for root cause + longer fix. Thanks all for quick coordination. :thumbsup:
